rca of the issue: N/A — previous iteration's crop bug has been fixed. Root cause was object-top on a 1086x1448 portrait scaled to fill a 1920x626 hero, which revealed only the top 24% (ceiling). Fix: change object-position to 50% 38% so the vertical slice reveals the technician's head (~30%) through mid-torso (~50%), which now correctly frames a person in the hero strip.
